name: psi4_logs_archive
purpose: The user, 19 Oct 2026: 'optie 1: een gecomprimeerd archief als release-bijlage in capstone-data op GitHub'. tools/archive_psi4_logs.py packs the psi4 logs the data mirror leaves out by name (the only copy of every displaced geometry's energy and gradient behind the corpus Hessians) into one xz archive with a sha256 list, outside the repository, and reads it back against the list. The upload is a separate, manual gh step

estimate.basis: not measured on the whole set: 7.4 GB of logs through xz preset 6 on one core; a 113 MB sample compressed 26x in seconds (scratchpad psi4_compress_sample.py). The progress lines every 25 files give the real rate

memory.basis: xz preset 6 uses about 94 MB to compress (liblzma's table); files are streamed in 1 MB blocks for hashing
